optServerDown.message: Saved, but no Fancy Bot server is answering at $1. Start it (double-click fancybot-setup.bat) and press Save again.

helpIntro.message: I read AI answers out loud in fun voices and help you understand them. Tap a topic:

helpListenBody.message: Ask Claude, Grok or Gemini anything. When the answer finishes, your character reads it out loud. Use the reading level slider: 1 is super simple, 5 is expert. Pick a voice style too.

helpGesturesBody.message: Drag me by the top bar. Long-press me for the menu (size, characters, mute). Double-tap me to open the helper. Tap me fast or rub me to tickle me.

helpHelperBody.message: Double-tap and type or say things like "switch to Old Oakley", "talk slower", "simpler please" or "talk like a genius". I change the setting for you.

helpAskBody.message: Key points gives the short version. Paraphrase says it in plain words. Oakley adds a wise thought. Ask a follow-up, or Expound to go deeper.

helpTownBody.message: Pick a few characters and they each take a part of the answer, like a little town meeting. Big Sal, Old Oakley, Big Play Ray and Elias are the core crew.

helpSocialBody.message: On X, Facebook and Instagram, tap the "Crib notes" pill on a post. Get crib notes (a witty summary) or a draft reply. Then copy it, make a video, or open the reply box. I never post for you: you choose what to post.

helpRoomBody.message: Pick 2 to 4 characters and a director. They pitch lines, the director picks the best, and you get a short scene about the post. Jokes are about ideas, never people.

helpHotBody.message: Turn it on to rank the posts already on your screen by likes and shared topics. Pick one to riff on.

helpVideoBody.message: After a narration, tap Video to download a clip with the character and captions, ready for you to upload.

helpSettingsBody.message: Tap the person icon to set your name, a little about you, your age range and language. Answers get tailored to you.

sceneCastTooSmall.message: Tick 2 to 4 characters for the scene. Using the core four this time.

sceneUnknownCast.message: Some picked characters aren't on this server yet (rerun fancybot-setup.bat). The scene used the others.

sceneOneSpeaker.message: Only $1 could speak this time: the AI didn't answer for $2. Wait a minute and try again.

sceneFewerSpeakers.message: $1 sat this one out: the AI didn't answer for them. Wait a minute and try again for the full cast.
